question.question_text: During the food preparation process, did the camera wearer use the kitchen scissors or the chopsticks more frequently?

answer_options.text: Neither the kitchen scissors nor the chopsticks were used
Kitchen scissors were used more frequently
Only the chopsticks were used, not the kitchen scissors
Both were used with the same frequency

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer used the kitchen scissors more frequently during the food preparation process. This is evidenced by the actions of cutting green beans and green pepper with the scissors, as well as cutting a packet and a bag with the scissors. The chopsticks were used less frequently, as they were picked up and put down, and there is no indication of their use in cutting actions.

evidence_index.source_content: Food preparation: places pot on dish rack, picks up bowl, washes vegetables, arranges scissors and fork on plate, adds cucumber, peas, cut beans to bowls/plates, cuts green beans and green pepper with scissors, puts vegetables in strainer, and cuts vegetables on plate with knife and fork.

Handling packets and pressure cooker: picks up chopsticks, picks up green packet and walks to sink, cuts packet with scissors, cuts bag with scissors and puts scissors on floor, wipes pressure cooker lid with towel, picks up bowl and puts on rack, and puts lid on bowl.
